responsibility: This file implements the Rust-specific GCC driver hooks that adjust command-line processing before compilation and linking. It scans decoded options to detect Rust inputs and relevant linker flags, ensures an `-o` output is present so multiple `.rs` inputs are forwarded correctly to `rust1`, preserves or adds libraries such as `-lc` and `-shared-libgcc` under the right conditions, and exports the standard driver entry points `lang_specific_driver`, `lang_specific_pre_link`, and `lang_specific_extra_outfiles` for the `gccrs` executable.
